definitions.explanation: Development carried out jointly by two or more parties, such as companies, countries, or research institutions. Common in business, technology, and international relations.

examples.japanese: {両社|りょうしゃ}で{共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}する。
examples.english: The two companies will develop it jointly.

examples.japanese: {日米|にちべい}{共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}の{新型|しんがた}ミサイルが{完成|かんせい}した。
examples.english: The new missile jointly developed by Japan and the U.S. has been completed.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}と{企業|きぎょう}の{共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}により、{画期的|かっきてき}な{新薬|しんやく}が{誕生|たんじょう}した。
examples.english: A groundbreaking new drug was born through joint development between a university and a company.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in news, business, and technology contexts. Can be used as a noun or with する. Often specifies the partners involved, such as {日米|にちべい}{共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ} (Japan-U.S. joint development).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}する (to jointly develop)
- {共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}{契約|けいやく} (joint development agreement)
- {共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}{事業|じぎょう} (joint development project)
- {共同|きょうどう}{開発|かいはつ}に{着手|ちゃくしゅ}する (to embark on joint development)
